capabilities: Render navigation cards from note-nav code blocks
Resolve and open internal links to previous and next notes
Show one card, both, or an empty-state message depending on defined notes
Adapt card styles to light and dark themes
Configure accent color from the settings color picker
disambiguation: Not an automatic prev/next pager; each card is defined manually by naming the previous and next notes in a note-nav code block.
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README is in Spanish and points to fuller documentation elsewhere; requires Obsidian 1.5.0+.
motivation: The author built it as a personal project for their own vault and published it so others can use it or build their own note navigation.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to render explicit prev/next navigation cards inside note content from a simple code block.
summary: Code block component that renders navigation cards linking to a previous note, next note, or both.
